answer: Sybil resistance rests on a scarce attestation: each new identity needs a sponsor who stakes a slashable bond, and that sponsor's standing degrades if the recruit misbehaves. A forger must compromise real members, not spin up keys. A flat mesa of thousands of fresh addresses gains nothing, because every layer of the trust graph multiplies the locked capital and the odds of losing all of it when one fake is flagged. Mirroring another member's record like a prism reflects a signal but cannot mint one, since depth is verified on chain. Each fake pays entry rent and climbs another terrace.
